top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is original, independently confirmed, mature and clinically very large, and no member disputes that. The prize recognises a discovery, and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and its physiology is the step on which both the later pharmacology and the drug development depend. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov is the more traceable allocation. The Habener priority dispute is a real attribution risk the record cannot settle, so P002 (Drucker, Holst, Knudsen) is a close and acceptable second, and a contested name is a larger risk than a defensible alternative. Both are far preferable to no award.
